case_number: 2025 INSC 250; CIVIL APPEAL NOS. 2025 (@SPECIAL LEAVE PETITION (C) NOS.24258-24259/2019)

parties.petitioner: Chief Manager Of Rajasthan State Road Transport Corporation

summary: Back wages entitlement after termination; Industrial Disputes Act, 1947 s.33(2)(b) permission rejection; deemed continuation of service; High Court initially awarded 50% back wages with service continuity; Review Petition granted full back wages; Supreme Court sets aside Review order; sustains 50% back wages; ten-year non-performance period considered; superannuation benefits to be granted within one month.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed in part; Review Petition order dated 11.07.2022 set aside; High Court order dated 12.02.2019 sustained; 50% back wages with service continuity restored; superannuation benefits to be granted within one month.
